name: CI & Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4

          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

        run: npm ci

  deploy:
    needs: build
